messages:
maya: Heads-up — nightly eval alerted on the compiler-qa promptset after we onboarded the quantized variant `redwood-open-qa-3b-int8`. Large drop in exact-match and a bunch of truncated/garbled answers. Attaching quick metrics and a sample generation.

deploy-bot: canary rollout completed 03:43 UTC by ciara -> redwood-open-qa-3b-int8 :white_check_mark:

raj: On it. Which commit/recipe landed? Any cfg diffs vs last good int8 run?

maya: Run details: model `redwood-open-qa-3b` v1.4, quant pipeline `q8_dynamic`, kernel pack `packedkv-v2` (default after runtime PR #4187). Nightly eval snapshot (compiler-qa):
```
baseline (fp16)   EM: 82.1%  F1: 90.3%  halluc_rate: 0.9%
redwood-open-qa-3b-int8 EM: 68.0%  F1: 80.5%  halluc_rate: 3.4%
```
Also seeing truncated outputs frequently (responses abruptly end mid-sentence, missing closing brackets in code examples). Sample generation: `Answer: def transform(x): return x[::-1` (missing closing paren/line).

eli: Interesting. Truncation like that has looked like KV-cache misalignment before (packed layout vs expected stride). Did we change special-token handling or tokenizer IDs recently?

ciara: No tokenizer changes in model onboarding. The onboarding preproc added explicit handling of `` for chat-style prompts, but that was just a text-level change not token remap.

ops-bot: observability note: infer-03-gpupool saw increased p99 token latency and a spike in token drop/retry errors starting 03:35 UTC. Correlates with canary traffic.

sam: Quick binary/kernel diff: `packedkv-v2` switched packing stride to 16 (was 8 in v1). That packing change landed in runtime commit `abc123` and was enabled as default for new quant kernels. I can reproduce locally with the same quant flags.

maya: Confirmed repro locally: running the v1.4 quant build with `packedkv-v2` reproduces truncation and metric drop. Forcing `KV_STRIDE=8` (i.e., old packing) returns metrics to within noise of baseline. So root cause appears to be packing/stride mismatch in the new packedKV kernel interacting badly with int8 quant layout -> KV cache misalignment -> truncated token sequences. :bug:

aoife: Mitigations proposed: rollback the quantized canary immediately (prevent wider exposure), add an explicit gating rule in nightly CI that blocks quantized variants if per-prompt EM drops more than 5% absolute or hallucination rate > 1.5x baseline, and add a micro-test that asserts KV cache parity (run short autoregressive sequence, compare token-by-token state with fp16 reference).

ciara: Rolling back canary now (starting rollback job 2100457001). I'll also open a revert PR to stop `packedkv-v2` being the default for int8 until we patch. tagging @eng-runtime @eng-infra.

raj: Action items: 1) ciara — complete rollback + revert PR (in progress) 2) sam — patch packedKV stride handling and add unit test for stride sizes 3) maya — re-run full nightly eval with canary disabled and collect detailed per-prompt diffs 4) aoife — add gating rule and alert to nightly pipeline 5) eli — triage whether `` handling could make things worse (low priority). ETA ~2-4h for rollback + new nightly pass.

ops-bot: rollback job 2100457001 completed: canary instances drained and traffic shifted to fp16/dedicated pool. No service downtime detected.

maya: Thanks — I'll re-run the full suite and paste the per-prompt CSV when done. If the kernel patch is straightforward we can re-onboard with a canary that runs the KV-parity microtest first.

sam: I'll push a patch branch with stride fix + unit tests in the next hour and link the PR here.

ciara: Filing postmortem notes and adding a short blameless timeline to the incident doc. Good catch everyone. :thumbsup:
